rows.grounds: munyādikaṃ = beginning with the sage; compound adjective (muni+ādi+ka), accusative singular neuter qualifying sarvam
prayogāntaṃ = ending with the application; compound (prayoga+anta), accusative singular neuter qualifying sarvam
sarvaṃ = all; pronoun/adjective, accusative singular neuter object
prāgvat = as before; indeclinable adverbial, appearing in sandhi within token prāgvatsamācaret
samācaret = one should perform; optative prescribing ritual performance, repeated as token samācaret
